q1_issues.issue: "from behind the clouds" is rendered as (Source sk_emerge_1 sk_clouds_1), which says the sun came out of the clouds themselves and drops the "behind" spatial relation entirely.

q2_gaps: complex / stacked prepositions ("from behind NP", "out from under NP", "from beneath NP") — the obliques section specifies only single-preposition heads plus Source/Goal, so the inner "behind" relation has no licensed slot
a static spatial relation between two entities other than containment (LocatedIn) or part-whole (PartOf) — nothing covers "X is behind Y"
notes: Definite "the sun" as a fresh unique-definite witness and definite plural "the clouds" as a GroupOf witness both follow the instruction set. Patient on the intransitive subject is a genuine coin-flip here (the "non-volitional natural process" list vs. "when unclear, Agent") and I do not count it against the parse.
